# Project submission or update

## Project or change

What does this help someone do with local AI? For a cloud integration, explain
its role in an agent workflow and its cloud requirements.

## Evidence and limitations

Link to upstream documentation for the description, hardware, compatibility, and
license. List important restrictions, preview status, telemetry, or permissions.

## Affiliation

Do you maintain, work on, or have a commercial connection to this project?
Self-submissions are welcome; disclose the connection here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I edited the source record and included evidence and an actual review date.
- [ ] I recorded the upstream license or explained uncertainty for maintainer review.
- [ ] I regenerated the README and ran catalog checks and tests, or explained why I could not.
- [ ] I agree to the contributor licensing terms in CONTRIBUTING.md.
